reviews.comment: Amazing professor!! So caring and genuinely passionate about Texas History. Took this class for hist core but ended up really enjoying it. #1 prof of all time - take this guy.  Tests (3) are all online, inlcuding the final. Two easy writing assignments. Attendance is 10% of grade, so show up.

TAKE DR. WEEKS! His lectures are engaging and funny, he offers unlimited extra credit, and exams are done online. The only thing I would beware of is to make sure to take note of specific numbers he mentions in lectures, they often show up on tests.
Amazing to get your history credit! he is funny and very interactive. Exams are online and everything he says in lecture is the same as the exams so take notes. TONS of extra credit!!!

Take Weeks! His passion for teaching is so strong and he really cares about his students. He is kind, understanding, and will help in any way possible. The only grades are 4 exams (including the final- not cumulative) and 2 written assignments which are nothing to stress over. His lectures are engaging, funny, and inspirational. My favorite prof!

Weeks is SO engaging and hilarious. Tests were in person a few semesters ago, but the review sheet had everything we need to know so I got easy A's every time. Attendance is required, but a girl a few rows ahead of me played papas freezeria on her ipad every class and still got an A. I only got a B bc I skipped an essay worth 15% lol.
GOAT. hilarious guy, dude just wants to see us succeed. he gives you extra credit opportunities the entire semester.

Dr. Weeks was a wonderful professor. As someone who has never really liked history, I genuinely looked forward to class. His lectures are engaging, and you can tell he is passionate about what he teaches. I would 100% recommend his class. The exams were straightforward and only a few, fairly easy written assignments.

He is by far my most favorite prof at A&M. He made his class very engaging and even though attendance is mandatory, the way he teaches makes you want to go to class. Going to class and studying gets you an A on exams. Never gave out busy work which did put a greater emphasis on test grades but it's so worth it. 100/10 you NEED to take this prof

I did enjoy Dr. Weeks' class and would recommend him as he is funny, caring, a good person, and makes this class easy. However, he often went on tangents and once almost spent a whole class discussing things unrelated to Texas History, such as his thoughts on political ideas and American economics. He is still a great guy and would recommend him.

Dr. Weeks is a god-send. He knows that the majority of his students need this class for their core curriculum, so he makes things easy. Tests were online unproctored, 2 writing assignments (bare minimum gets you a 100), and multiple extra credit opprotunities. Go to class, attendance is crucial to your grade, but you want to because he is awesome.

Truly one of the best professors I have ever had at TAMU. So inspiring and passionate with great views on his course and society as a whole. Attendance is mandatory but he makes you want to show up and his lectures are entertaining. Assignments are minimal and if you go to class, you will do really well.

Dr Weeks is incredible! You can tell how genuine of a person he is, and that he loves what he does! He cares about his students so much. All assignments and exams are online with is awesome, attendance is taken and mandatory but with how easy the class is it's worth it. Take him, I hate history and actually enjoyed listening to his classes!

As a history hater, this was hands down the best history class that I've taken ever. Attendance is mandatory, but Dr. Weeks makes it so I would go to class if it wasn't. His lectures were genuinely inspiring and opened my eyes to understand that everyone views the elephant differently. I learned so much beyond Texas history. Tests online to!

TAKE THIS PROF!!! I hate history, and I absolutely loved this class and Prof Weeks. The class is an easy A as long as you go to every lecture and listen because the exams line up very closely with them. The sweetest man ever, and he makes the effort not to teach history from the "white man's" point of view.
Quite literally the best teacher I have ever had. If you have the opportunity to take one of his classes, DO IT! You will not regret it!

Amazing prof! Lectures are incredible. Three tests (mix of m/c and short answer) and one research paper (easy). He gives a study guide beforehand that is basically the test and lets you write two of the short answer questions before the exam. Really cares about history and is super understanding and a kind man. Does not force ideologies on you.

If you have the opportunity to take this professor for ANY class, TAKE IT!!! This is one of the best professors I have ever had, arguably one of the best at A&M! Participate & ask questions! He encouraged class participation & would often stay after to answer more. He greatly contributed to my learning & was very helpful to make future historians.

I actually took him for HIST 370: Civil War and Reconstruction. Dr. Weeks is a wonderful professor and is knowledgeable about his topics. He is passionate about his work but also his students. He is by far one of my favorite professors I've taken and I'm set to take two more of his classes in the fall. He has 3 exams and 2 writing assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: PLEASE TAKE DR. WEEKS. He is the most amazing professor ever. His lectures are fun to listen to and he is so funny. The class is based on four exams and two writing assignments, but none of it is very hard as long as you do the study guides and put effort into your writing. He knows his stuff and loves to answer questions.

DR.WEEKS THANK YOU!!! This course is only graded off of 3 exams and writing assignments (they are not essays, you have to write a paragraph for each of the questions) His exams and study guides lined up perfectly with the material he taught which you don't see very often anymore lol. I would take over HIST105/106 anyday.

This class is an easy A if you're willing to sit through all of his political jargon. Class grade is based off of 3 exams and 2 written assignments. Tests were easy, but make sure to show up to class because not everything is on the study guide. Written assignments are easy if you write them based off of the lecture, but his TAs never gave feedback
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Words don't do justice how much this guy was the best history prof I've ever had. He was great in pretty much every aspect. Lectures were fun and entertaining. The class wasn't hard at all and I still learned a lot. The guy is a total sweetheart and cares about his students.

Professor Weeks is a great human being and he truly cares about Texas history and teaching us how it actually happened.  He goes very into depth and clearly explains everything.  Attendance is required and is 10% of the final grade, but the tests and papers are easy and fun to do.  If you enjoy Texas history or need a history class, TAKE THIS!

TAKE THIS MAN. This class is not a hard class at all. The lectures are interesting and he puts in a lot of effort to make them entertaining. He cares so much about Texas and his students. He is a super caring man and loves what he does. I would take this class over and over again to have him as a prof. Only 2 out of class assignments.

Dr. Weeks is an amazing professor, he truly cares about his students success. His lectures are exactly what will be on the test, so take notes or go over the slides for studying. You will be graded on 4 exams and 2 writing assignments. I would recommend taking his class.

This professor clearly likes what he does and cares for your grade. I fully recommend taking him. I have learned more in his class than any other history class I have taken. The way he lectures seems to stick with you and make you enjoy the class.

This is the first history class I've ever liked, he explains well which led me to get a B+. He got behind a little at the end of the semester but got back on track and covered everything. He doesn't rush through the notes and normally we wait until everyone is done writing from his slides.

This prof is very caring and his material is extremely easy as he's more concerned with teaching rather than assigning a bunch of homework. There are only a couple of short assignments and the Tests that's really it this prof was fantastic. Easy A

Dr. Weeks is the reason I continued to want to be a history teacher. I hated history until end of high school. My first semester in college (summer 4 week course) I got him as my 1301 teacher and he is spectacular!!! He's very sweet and it's obvious he cares about his career. He's a woke guy with amazingly easy tests if you take any notes at all

If you have never liked history before, I highly recommend him! He teaches America's checkered past without using coverups or excuses. He's a very sweet man who cares for the next generation, and what they will make of their history. He's the reason I decided to continue down my path as a history major :)

Don't get me wrong, he is one of the best profs I have ever had. but if you care for your grade I wouldn't take him. his class is all fun and barely any work. but he literally never gave us grades for anything, until my final grade showed up on my transcript. Not to mention he never responds to emails. lol I emailed like 30 times.

His lectures are entertaining. The class is graded on only 3 exams and a 3-5 page paper due at the end of the semester. However, his tests are everything that is on the powerpoints. He is super sweet and caring.

Weeks is a great prof! Even though I've never loved Texas History, Weeks' course was interesting to me. He's very easy to talk to during office hours and via email. Super nice guy who genuinely cares about all of his students! One of my favorite professors ever!

Proffessor Weeks was by far the best prof I ever had. He cares about his students success, he is passionate about the material, so in turn it helps you learn it easier. You do have to write one essay but he puts you in a good position to be successful and is extremely available and helpful.

Professor Weeks is everything a professor should be. He is caring, understanding, and simply wants his students to learn about the material he is teaching. He is not trying to screw your GPA, he just wants you to learn and have fun along the way. Great guy, great prof. Three multiple choice tests and an essay. Simple, fun and not to time consuming.

This prof was awesome! There were only 3 tests and 1 essay. The essay was over anything you wanted as long as it was Texas related. Attendance was taken but it was not that big of a deal. The prof was really nice and made the class interesting. The tests were straightforward, just pay attention in class and you'll be okay.

If I could take him again I would. There is no one as passionate as him about what he teaches. He is woke af and knows the importance of history, not to mention is makes learning interesting by involving current events. Tests were so easy just had to study powerpoints and attendance is mandatory but I loved the class. 1 essay tho but it was easy!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved Professor Weeks and looked forward to going to class. He is truly passionate about Texas History and tells it as a story and not just boring information on a slide. The class consisted of four grades, three tests that are easy if you take notes and an essay where you get to choose the topic. Highly recommend!!

Best professor ever!! 3 tests and 1 essay and the tests are super straight forward. You can choose any essay topic as long as it relates to TX history. I actually looked forward to attending his lectures. He cares about his students. TAKE HIM!!! you wont regret it! I wish I could take him again

Professor Weeks is my favorite professor of ALL time. He is such a kind & caring person who really just wants you to learn a little about what he's teaching to make you a better person. The tests are easy. As a science major, I HATE history but he has made learning about it so much easier. If you have the chance TAKE HIM!! You will NOT regret it!!

This class was an easy A. All the information needed is on the slides, honestly just take notes and review for an hour before tests and you will do great. He is a great lecturer, and grades very generously. Very approachable person. Grades are 3 tests and an essay.

The class was extremely easy and the teacher made a decently boring subject infinitely more interesting than I expected it to be. There are 3 tests over units and a non-cumulative final which is just like all the other tests. There was also an essay over a prompt of your choice , which he gave the opportunity to turn in early for 10 extra points.

Lectures are good. Posts all of power points online. 3 tests, final is not accumulative. Gives test review that comes straight from power point. Attendance not needed but good to make sure you get an A. Honestly just a super nice guy who is more than willing to work with you and wants you to succeed.

My absolute favorite professor this year. 3 tests that are fairly easy A's if you just study a bit the day before. Offered extra credit for turning in the essay early. He used to be a Baptist preacher, and his cheesy jokes show it. His lectures are unbiased and I truly felt like I learned valuable things. For sure take him.

He was definitely my favorite professor this semester. His lectures were extremely interesting and it shows that he is passionate about what he teaches. He gives reviews for every test and as long as you do those, you should be fine like you honestly don't need the textbook. He doesn't always take attendance, it depends if he notices low attendance
3 exams and one essay, optional attendance. Helpful reviews and resources online. Best class I've taken by far - highly recommend!

Professor Weeks is amazing! He says you need the textbook but I never opened it once. He gives reviews for his test and just study those the day before and you will ace them. Your grade is three tests (including the final which is not cumulative) and one essay which you get 10 bonus point if you turn in early. He is a must take prof!

Normally I hate history classes, but I actually liked this one! He tells Texas history like a story and doesn't get too caught up in details; he just wants us to know the big picture. Used to be a middle school teacher and it shows. Tests were easy if you went to lectures and reviewed your notes.
His lectures are hilarious and entertaining, he takes attendance but it doesn't seem to matter too much. He's very thorough in his teaching and makes a study guide, and the tests are very easy.

By far the best teacher I have had at A&M this far. He is passionate about what he is talking about and gives good life advice along the way. He is also hilarious so I actually enjoy going to this class. Follow the study guide and know everything on it and you'll get As on all the tests! take him!!!!
He's an amazing professor. As long as you skim through the book and listen in class you will do great!
